Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier assigned when the owner joins a
                household (created with 'sharesHousehold' true against an
                existing owner who has the same last name and address). All
                owners in the same household share this value. Null when the
                owner does not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName
                and lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this
                owner was created, i.e. before this create. Zero when the name
                was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level assigned at creation,
                ranging from 1 to 3. It starts at 1, gains 1 when an email
                address is present, gains 1 when the owner had no namesakes at
                creation (namesakeCount is 0), and is capped at 3. Level 4 is
                reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created on this
                owner's registration date, signalling a bulk-signup surge;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true

          title: Telephone number

              title: Initials
              description: >-

              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed

                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier assigned when the owner joins a
                household (created with 'sharesHousehold' true against an
                existing owner who has the same last name and address). All
                owners in the same household share this value. Null when the
                owner does not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName
                and lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this
                owner was created, i.e. before this create. Zero when the name
                was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level assigned at creation,
                ranging from 1 to 3. It starts at 1, gains 1 when an email
                address is present, gains 1 when the owner had no namesakes at
                creation (namesakeCount is 0), and is capped at 3. Level 4 is
                reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true

              description: >-

## Summary

I consolidated all owner duplicate detection into a single derived `identityKey`.

**`identityKey` definition** — `normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + (householdId or empty)`. Since the stored telephone is already normalized to E.164 and email is stored lower‑cased, the key is derived directly from persisted fields.

**Changes:**

1. **`Owner.java`** — added a `@Transient` derived getter `getIdentityKey()` that builds the key from `telephone`, `email` and `householdId` (nulls → empty). `@Transient` + field-access mapping keeps it out of the persistence model.

2. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `identityKey` string to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it and MapStruct auto-maps `owner.getIdentityKey()` into the response.

3. **`ClinicService` / `ClinicServiceImpl`** — added `existsOwnerWithIdentityKey(String)`, which returns true only when some existing owner's whole `getIdentityKey()` equals the candidate's.

4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — removed the three separate 409 checks (telephone, email, and the `!sharesHousehold && householdExists` household reject) and replaced them with one check on the full `identityKey` after household assignment (which still runs so `householdId` is populated before the key is computed). The per-city capacity and per-day quota rules are unchanged, as they aren't duplicate checks.

**Behavioural effect:** only an exact full-key match is now a duplicate. Two members of the same household with different telephones produce different keys and are both allowed; the acceptance test `coreRejectsIdentityCollision` (same telephone, no email, no household → identical keys) correctly gets a 409.

I left the now-unused `existsOwnerWithTelephone`/`existsOwnerWithEmail` service+repository methods in place rather than ripple deletions through the interface and all three repository implementations — say the word if you'd prefer them removed as dead code.

Note: this directory isn't a git repository, so I made no commit.
